nodes.label: Gemini Agent Project Context
nodes.rationale: Instructional context for Gemini agents working on Reasoner. Covers 8-phase pipeline architecture, multi-provider routing (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/Perplexity/Mistral/xAI/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/GLM/MiniMax), CLI/API/frontend interfaces, development conventions, testing guidelines, and workflow orchestration rules.
